slate_server.help.home: [name] - Teleport to one of your homes.
slate_server.help.sethome: [name] - Set a home where you stand. An existing name moves it.
slate_server.help.back: - Go back to where your last teleport began, or to where you died.
slate_server.help.setspawn: - Move the spawn to where you stand.
slate_server.help.setwarp: <name> [description] - Create a warp where you stand, or move it there.
slate_server.help.rtp: - Teleport to a safe random place.
slate_server.help.tpa: <player> - Ask to teleport to a player.
slate_server.help.tpahere: <player> - Ask a player to teleport to you.
slate_server.help.tpcancel: - Give up your teleport and the requests you sent.
slate_server.help.tptoggle: - Switch teleport requests to you off or on.
slate_server.help.afk: - Mark yourself as away, or as back.
slate_server.help.seen: <player> - When a player was last on.
slate_server.help.playtime: [player] - How long a player has played.
slate_server.help.kit: [id] - Take a kit, or list them. Staff: create <id> [cooldown], delete <id>, give <player> <id>.
slate_server.help.freeze: <player> [time] [reason] - Hold a player where they stand.
slate_server.help.tempban: <player> <time> [reason] - Ban a player for a time.
slate_server.help.kick: <player> [reason] - Throw a player off the server.
slate_server.help.history: <player> - A player's punishments and the notes on them.
slate_server.help.note: <player> <text> - Write a note on a player.
slate_server.help.feed: [player] - Restore hunger, and thirst where a thirst mod keeps it.
slate_server.help.vanish: [player] - Become invisible to players, or visible again.
slate_server.help.speed: <0-10> [player] - Set walking and flying speed (1 is normal).
slate_server.help.endersee: <player> - Look into a player's ender chest.
slate_server.help.tpo: <player> - Teleport to a player, or to where they last were.
slate_server.help.role: list | info <role> | create <id> [priority] | delete <role> | give <player> <role> [time] | take <player> <role> | player <player> | allow, deny, unset <role> <node> | number <role> <node> <value or unset> | prefix, name, color, priority <role> <value> | inherit, disinherit <role> <other> - Roles and their permissions.
